subject.title: [Feature]: Matrix QA lifecycle parity across Tuwunel and Crabline

question: Should Matrix QA adopt the substrate-neutral lifecycle contract and Crabline-backed adapter proposed by https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101055?
rationale: The remaining work is an intentional QA infrastructure feature with a dependency-graph change and a maintainer label, so automation should not decide the permanent substrate contract or dependency acceptance.

options.title: Review the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the lifecycle contract, Crabline dependency, and Testbox proof in the linked implementation PR.

options.title: Choose a different contract
options.body: Keep this issue open but ask for a narrower or different Matrix QA lifecycle shape before implementation lands.

options.title: Defer the parity work
options.body: Leave the current Tuwunel-specific restart harness in place and close both items only if maintainers decide the parity work is not worth owning now.

recommendation.title: Review the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers review the lifecycle contract, Crabline dependency, and Testbox proof in the linked implementation PR.

likelyOwner.reason: RomneyDa opened the issue and linked implementation PR, and recent Matrix QA history points to the same area ownership.
